facts.value: Accessory1 callback for the captured fighter's initial CaptureKirby state. It conditionally recomputes model scale from the pre-step XY residual, reduces residual components using independently configured limits, refreshes the linked Kirby's capture point, and updates world position relative to that point. Convergence and visual shrinking depend on valid finite parameters; it performs no motion-state transition.

facts.rationale: Records exact ordering, overwrite of the temporary, conditional scale output, and non-assumed X operand.
facts.value: Reads stored pos_offset into a temporary Vec3 with Z=0. Before modifying that residual, computes its length and may write JObj scale using x8.x as threshold and x8.y as reduction coefficient. X is multiplied by canonical mv.co.guard.x2C; Y/Z by capturekirby.scale.y/z. It then bounds each temporary XY component, subtracts it from persistent pos_offset, calls ftKb_SpecialN_800F5B5C on victim_gobj to overwrite the temporary with the partner capture point, and writes cur_pos.xy as point plus new residual and cur_pos.z directly from the point. No stored partner pointer is released or validated here.

evidence.why: Exact scaling guard/formula, X operand, signed component limits, and write order.

facts.rationale: Supersedes an unproved per-axis layout equivalence and adds strict boundaries and explicit validity assumptions.
facts.value: Let d be the pre-step residual length, R=x8.x and k=x8.y. Only d<R writes scale, with factor (1-k)+(d/R)*k; equality/outside leaves existing scale unchanged. X multiplies guard.x2C, not a proved saved-scale alias; Y/Z multiply saved capture scales. For finite nonnegative d, R<=0 skips scaling. No restriction on k guarantees shrinking or positive scale. Each XY step is the residual unless ABS(residual)>limit, in which case it is limit times the sign selected by residual<0. Finite nonnegative limits give non-overshooting componentwise convergence; zero limits stall nonzero offsets, negative limits can reverse movement, and NaNs/infinities are not sanitized. Position is refreshed after residual subtraction, Z follows the partner exactly, and no transition occurs.
